title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 195 ]

blocks.text: Suppose a football game begins at 1:00 p.m. in New York. It is then 6:00 p.m. in London. Which time is correct? Both are, because the time on a clock depends on where you are. Something similar happens in space. If an explosion occurred on a star, scientists on the earth would record the time it happened. But someone traveling through another part of the universe at a very different speed would record the time differently. According to Einstein's theory of relativity, there is no single absolute time for everyone.
